# Gāthāsaṅgaṇika (Pvr 10)

**ID:** Pvr 10  
**Section:** Parivāra (pvr)

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Gāthāsaṅgaṇika* ("Verses on the training rules") is the tenth chapter of the *Parivāra*, the final book of the Pali Vinaya Piṭaka. It presents an interrogation and exposition of monastic discipline and Vinaya topics formatted as an exchange of verses. Modern translations include an English rendering by Bhikkhu Brahmali. The text and its versified rulings—including a section referred to in commentary as the *Dutiya-gāthā-saṅgaṇika*—are treated in the Vinaya exegetical tradition, such as the *Samantapāsādikā* (preserved in Chinese translation as the *Shan-Chien-P'i-P'o-Sha*), where commentators expound verses concerning dawn rising in relation to offences such as *Nissaggiya Pācittiya* and *Saṅghādisesa* [Bapat and Hirakawa 1970].

 Related verses or references also appear across Pali texts such as the *Udāna* (Ud 5.5), *Theragāthā* (Thag 6.13), the *Khandhaka* (Kd 19), *Nettippakaraṇa* (Ne 37), and *Peṭakopadesa* (Pe 2).
